name: Every Nth buy reward — contributor reference
author: REPLACE_WITH_AUTHOR_WALLET

management.summary: View eligible buys and native rewards, fund the isolated budget, claim ETH, and reclaim unused budget after expiry from the fixed refund wallet.

reads.label: Eligible buys
reads.description: Counts qualifying buy callbacks, including skipped rewards when funding is insufficient.

reads.label: Rewards earned
reads.description: Number of buyers credited from available funding.

reads.label: Budget remaining
reads.description: Read with the verified instanceId, never a caller-provided arbitrary bucket.

reads.label: Your ETH claim
reads.description: Read with verified instanceId and connected wallet.

reads.label: Your claimed ETH
reads.description: Cumulative paid amount for verified instanceId and connected wallet.

reads.label: Unused budget wallet
reads.description: Fixed launch configuration; this is separate from the contributor royalty wallet.

reads.label: Rewards end at
reads.description: Unix seconds. At this exact time buys stop qualifying and unused-budget reclaim becomes available.

reads.label: Unused budget returned to claims
reads.description: Total unused funds credited to the fixed refund wallet; not the amount already withdrawn.

actions.label: Reclaim unused budget
actions.description: Dispatch only via runtime.executeAction as declared in runtime-binding.json. At or after endsAt, move available budget into a backed refundWallet claim; preserve winner claims. Inputs are exactly zero bytes.
